name: kallob-funnel
description: Kallob Funnel for Codex: sales funnels for your shop, written by Codex and run from your own Cloudflare.

interface.shortDescription: Sales funnels for your shop, written by Codex
interface.longDescription: Open Kallob Funnel on this machine: pick a funnel (gift, event, booking, sales, coupon, catalog, recruiting, quiz, bridge page), fill a short form, and Codex writes every page. Funnels go online on your own Cloudflare; leads and orders come back to this machine. Your Kallob account decides whether Kallob Funnel is open.
defaultPrompt: Make a gift funnel in Kallob Funnel.
